name: Southern States Packaging Co
old_description: Our packaging company offers cardboard Tier Sheets that are manufactured from multiple plies of 100% Virgin Food Grade Paperboard specifically designed for flatness, stability, and longevity.
about:
Southern States Packaging Company operates from Spartanburg, South Carolina, where it was founded in 1984. The company began as a manufacturer and supplier of converted paper and paperboard products, strategically positioned near raw material suppliers and major transportation corridors including Interstates 85, 26, 77, and 95, as well as East Coast ports and CSXT rail service.

The company produces cardboard tier sheets, slip sheets, and coated paperboard rolls, all made from 100% virgin food-grade paperboard. Its converting services include coating, laminating, and die-cutting, with additional capabilities such as slip-assist and anti-skid coatings. The facility emphasizes Six Sigma quality control and continuous improvement, though specific square footage and headcount are not publicly disclosed.

Southern States serves a diverse, blue-chip customer base across North America, Central America, South America, Europe, and Asia. Its products are used in food packaging and industrial shipping applications, providing cost-effective alternatives to wooden and plastic pallets for both food products and industrial parts.

The company differentiates itself through its strategic location, BRC Global Standard for Packaging Materials certification, and commitment to sustainable, recyclable, and biodegradable packaging solutions. Continuous investment in modern equipment and a focus on zero-defect quality aim to drive supply chain efficiencies for customers.
